items.q: What is included in your SEO services?
items.a: A technical audit, keyword mapping, on-page fixes, content, local SEO and Google Business Profile work, link building and AI search optimization, tracked in your own Search Console and GA4.

items.q: Do you do technical SEO audits?
items.a: Yes. We check speed, indexing, crawl errors and mobile usability, then fix what holds your pages back.

items.q: Do I need SEO if I already run ads?
items.a: Ads stop the day the money stops, while a page that ranks keeps bringing people. Most businesses use both.
No lock-in beyond the notice period, and you get proper GST invoices.

items.q: How do you choose which keywords to target?
items.a: We map each keyword to one page, based on what your customers search for and how competitive the term is.

items.q: Can you help me appear in AI answers like Google AI Overviews?
items.a: Yes. We make pages easy to understand and cite, with clear answers, FAQ sections with schema and strong brand and author signals.
